script:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 memory.html ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/dbaf827c094e6de20436c328abdd63cfd22bb3e4/memory.html' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/memory.html?ref=dbaf827c094e6de20436c328abdd63cfd22bb3e4' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: memory.html'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '94598dde844f76f4304118d66b5c281c739199791e6bdcbb93fd21020e1f0913' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=94598dde844f76f4304118d66b5c281c739199791e6bdcbb93fd21020e1f0913"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/cbd187a42b92c7319d6ddb80722fa0f5bb6a9032/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js?ref=cbd187a42b92c7319d6ddb80722fa0f5bb6a9032' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '1145e10694f5c60c07cfe68b51682224af782fd4b44c8d9958f10a726699f337' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=1145e10694f5c60c07cfe68b51682224af782fd4b44c8d9958f10a726699f337"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-3d.js'
rm -rf /tmp/_xm_front_sync
